text: 🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
With Haven grieving, The Red Table installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/9/4), 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

◈ SYSTEM: "34. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,456 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
With Haven grieving, The Red Table installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 11,250 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

[sys] 📺 Hardened The Auction. The System auctions alien tech. Bid with memories, years, or body parts. Everyone pays their bid — winner takes the lot, losers take the loss. The rules have changed. The audience demanded it.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

[sys] 📺 Bidding war. A Gray Hollow contestant just bid their childhood. Someone else bid a lung (they have two, they point out, which is technically true).

The lots are extraordinary. The prices are obscene. The audience is euphoric.

📺 "Raise" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 Final lot. The hammer is raised. Everything bid so far is already gone — paid, taken, consumed.

This is the last chance. The tech on the block could change your village's winter.

📺 "Everything" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 The bell — a sound like a dropped pan in a cathedral.

You circle. They circle. The ref-drone ticks off the seconds, loud enough for the cheap seats, while the crowd picks sides and heckles both of you.

📺 "Trade blows" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 They yield — or they don't. The ref-drone hovers, sensors hot.

The crowd wants blood. The System wants a story. You want to go home.

📺 "Press the advantage" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.
